name: HushMap
tagline: A live noise map of campus study spots with voice answers about the quietest place.
problem: Students waste trips to loud study spots; noise overwhelms neurodivergent students.
solution: Sensor devices report decibel levels to an interactive map with history; a voice assistant answers where it is quiet.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for the quietest spot and get a spoken answer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best UI/UX Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Real sensor data rather than estimates.

lessons: Live local data makes a map worth opening.
